svg.title: Gilil On — blue-navy — flat face and one soft shadow
svg.desc: Gilil: one solid face, one soft cast shadow. No side faces, bevel, highlights, stroke, extrusion or steps. Face contour reused from approved cyan reconstruction. Original On and base scene unchanged. Local background reconstruction only where removing baked Gilil relief/shadow reveals unknown plate. Paths/gradients only; no embedded images or font dependencies.
